name: arabic
description: Claude Code in Arabic: replies and thinking in Arabic, right-to-left text fixed in terminals without BiDi support

rtl.title: RTL mode
rtl.description: visual: the mod reorders Arabic for terminals with no BiDi (Windows Terminal, VS Code, macOS Terminal, iTerm2). native: your terminal does BiDi itself (WezTerm with bidi_enabled, Konsole, GNOME Terminal, mlterm).

thinking.title: Thinking language
thinking.description: Language Claude reasons in. English can be slightly sharper and cheaper; replies are Arabic either way.
